about: Search benchmark for oml doc --search (tests/search-check.ps1). tune: the queries used to tune weights and synonyms. held: 60 held-out queries written blind by an independent evaluator after tuning, never used for tuning; do not tune on them. blind2: 30 blind queries written by a reviewer (general words; read after the held-out evaluation). held and blind2 were later used to cross-validate the synonym gate and concept links, so they are no longer blind. blind3: 60 blind queries from a final independent evaluator (mostly broad, general words; 6 typos, 6 mixed, 4 unanswerable), measured once for the release number; the glossary and stem fixes were later cross-validated on all four sets, so none of them is blind any more. blind4: 60 blind queries from a last independent evaluator (same mix: 44 broad, 6 typos, 6 mixed, 4 unanswerable), written without the engine, the maps or the earlier sets, measured once with no ranking change: the release number. expect: ids from oml doc --search-list that answer the query (a section also accepts its rows and any entry with the same command); empty expect: our docs cannot answer it (note says why).
